citations.claim: At first violating step 148, N (approach 0) is green during NS green phase with emergency active, violating all_red clearance (0s < 1s required)
One step before violation (147), opposite direction EW is still yellow (not yet red), so all-red has not started
Two steps before violation (146), EW is green, confirming no all-red interval occurred between EW green/yellow and NS green

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event (t=147 N) - one field change (events). Without emergency, the normal cycle respects all-red and yellow durations, so no violation occurs in 148 steps.

explanation: Emergency preemption immediately forces NS green at step 148 while EW was yellow at step 147 and green at 146, skipping the required all-red clearance (need 1s, got 0s) and truncating EW yellow to 1s (need 6s). The controller's emergency handling bypasses the normal all-red phase and yellow-duration enforcement.

violation.detail: approach 0 turned green after only 0 s of all-red (need 1 s)

vision_note: At steps 145-146 the EW approaches are green while NS is red, and at 147 EW turns yellow. At 148 NS is already green with no all-red interval in between, so the yellow is shown for only one frame before the conflicting direction goes green.
